title: Bind the watcher's lifetime to the launcher and prove the cleanup
statement: Make the documented launcher own both the application process and the watcher, terminating the watcher with the application. Verify by observation after termination: no watcher process, nothing listening on the port, no surviving temporary directory.
notes: ⚠️ Deliberately AFTER the change stream, because there is no watcher to own until then. ⚠️ The skeleton's create-on-`listen` / close-in-`close()` pattern does not carry: under `next start` there is no server object the application owns. Choosing the binding is this task's work, and DEC-0022 states the obligation without a mechanism for exactly that reason. ⚠️ Verified by observation, not by the absence of an error — the destroy path's own rule.
